entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I have a problem with my VeloBand Pulse. It's just not working at all. I've had it for about a month and I'm just so confused by it.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

Oh, it's definitely a technical thing. It just won't sync with my phone, no matter what I do. I feel like it's broken. I'm just so overwhelmed with all the buttons and apps... I think the device must be defective. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can absolutely help you. It's frustrating when a new product doesn't work right out of the box. Let me pull up your account. Can I have your email address, please?
Thank you, Alex. I see your account right here. It looks like the VeloBand Pulse was delivered on December 17th, so about 33 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes, that sounds right. Is that a problem? I don't really understand the policies, I just know it's not working.

No problem at all. Let me just check our policy for you... one moment... Okay, yes. Our policy states that you have a 90-day window to return items. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can go ahead and process a full return for this defective item.
And I also see that you're one of our VIP members. To make this easier for you, I'll waive the return shipping fee and ensure your refund is processed as soon as the carrier scans the package.
Oh, really? You can just take it back? That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much! I was so worried I was stuck with a broken gadget.
It's my pleasure to help. I'm emailing you the pre-paid return label right now. You can just print it out and attach it to the original packaging. Is there anything else I can do for you today, Alex?
No, that's perfect. You've been a great help. Thank you again, Diana.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
